_doc: House voice standard v3.0 (sv-12-voice, Option B1 corpus-calibrated 2026-11-24): Native 1.0x Hải Đăng preset with gentle per-sentence rhythm (target_ups 4.70, phonation_ups 4.90, blend_raw 0.65, pitch_ratio 1.00, tempo_clamp [0.95, 1.08]), natural pause preservation (inside pauses >0.55s -> 0.25s, sentence_gap_s 0.24s, clause_pad_s 0.08s incl. em-dashes), bilingual <en>...</en> and VieNeu V3 Turbo emotion tags allowed. Shared by every episode; do not edit per episode.

engine._why: VieNeu V3 Turbo preset Hải Đăng with use_ref_codes=True and temperature=0.7/top_k=25/top_p=0.95, synthesized sentence-by-sentence at native 1.0x pace (4.64-4.69 raw ups) with gentle tempo_clamp [0.95, 1.08] and blend_raw=0.65 so natural human cadence and 20-24% pause breathing room are preserved without metallic WSOLA speedup.

rhythm._doc: v3.0 Native 1.0x Hải Đăng breathing rhythm (Option B1, calibrated against 11 SCRIPT_YOUTUBE ref MP4s at 19.6-23.8% audio pause ratio). Eliminates v2.0 1.14-1.42x WSOLA acceleration and 0.32->0.16s pause crushing. Authors may override wps, pause_after (up to 1.20s for silent visual holds), tts_text, or seed per segment/sentence in script.json.

text._doc: Rules for spoken text (tts_text if present, else text). script_lint SC-15..SC-17 and voice.py enforce them.
text._why: Numbers must be written in words for predictable reading; '...' and '…' and '—' are allowed for natural breathing because inside_pause_threshold_s preserves pauses up to 0.55s and trims longer holes cleanly to 0.25s; VieNeu V3 Turbo's 3 native inline emotion tokens are allowed and stripped from captions; English terms use <en>...</en> or top-level 'english': [...].

line_checks._doc: Every segment is measured against profile (below). [min, max]. If a sentence/segment fails, offending sentences regenerate with the next deterministic seed up to engine.max_attempts.

episode_checks._between_words_why: Same chain and measure as G6 (audiolib.voice_chain + between_words_db, mix_targets voice.between_words_db). Measured at G3 so a noisy take is re-made before shots are timed to it.

profile._doc: Calibrated native 1.0x Hải Đăng profile under v3.0 breathing rhythm (target_ups 4.70, pitch_ratio 1.00, inside holes >0.55s trimmed to 0.25s). rate_wps is syllable-units / segment duration.
profile.calibrated: 2026-11-24, VieNeu V3 Turbo Hải Đăng preset (t0.7/k25/p0.95, use_ref_codes=True) native 1.0x rhythm (target_ups=4.70, blend_raw=0.65, pitch_ratio=1.00) calibrated against 41-folder SCRIPT_YOUTUBE corpus.
